recipes.description: Place a bucket of lava against an Active Molten Asurine vent and it will be converted to Asurine.
Place a bucket of lava against an Active Molten Crimsite vent and it will be converted to Crimsite.
Place a bucket of lava against an Active Molten Ochrum vent and it will be converted to Ochrum.
Place a bucket of lava against an Active Molten Scorchia vent and it will be converted to Scorchia.
Place a bucket of lava against an Active Molten Scoria vent and it will be converted to Scoria.
Place a bucket of lava against an Active Molten Veridium vent and it will be converted to Veridium.
